faq_description: The biblical foundations guiding our life's work, ministry operations, and teaching principles.
faq_product_quality_title: What do we believe about the Holy Bible?
faq_product_quality_description: We believe the Bible is the inspired, infallible, and authoritative Word of God.
faq_product_categories_title: What do we believe about God?
faq_product_categories_description: We believe One God exists eternally in three Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
faq_power_solutions_title: What do we believe about Jesus Christ?
faq_power_solutions_description: We believe Jesus Christ, the eternal Son of God, became fully man while remaining fully God. He was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, lived a sinless life, died on the cross, rose bodily, and ascended to heaven.
faq_mobile_accessories_title: What do we believe about Salvation?
faq_mobile_accessories_description: We believe Salvation is by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone — not by works — and is available to all who repent and believe in Him.
faq_storage_devices_title: What do we believe about the Holy Spirit?
faq_storage_devices_description: We believe the Holy Spirit indwells and empowers believers to live godly lives and equips them for service and witness.
faq_pricing_title: What do we believe about the Church?
faq_pricing_description: We believe the Church is the Body of Christ, called to worship God, make disciples, and serve the world in love.
faq_availability_title: What do we believe about the Second Coming?
faq_availability_description: The Second Coming of Jesus Christ is the blessed hope of the Church, when He will return to reign and make all things new.
faq_warranty_support_title: What do we believe about Marriage?
faq_warranty_support_description: We believe that God designed marriage as a covenantal bond between one man and one woman.
faq_customer_support_title: What do we believe about Human Life?
faq_customer_support_description: We believe that human life is sacred from conception to its natural end; we must have concern for both physical and spiritual needs.

tagline: The Evolution of Steward of Life Ministry
title: A Focused Transformation Group
description: Founded in Addis Ababa as an inspired religious initiative, Steward of Life has grown into a highly intentional community architecture. Today, each of our core pillars runs with targeted focus, pastoral leadership, and an active operational rhythm.
infraDescription: We optimize our ministry sectors by handling foundational pillars centrally. By using shared infrastructure, our counselors and youth mentors focus exclusively on changing lives without administrative friction.
vmv_heading: Leaders shaped to serve, not to be served
vmv_intro: Three statements hold this work together: where we are going, what we do to get there, and what we refuse to trade away along the way.
vmv_vision_body: To see Christ-centered servant leaders who transform families, churches, institutions, and nations.
vmv_anchor_text: The Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve.
vmv_mission_body: To equip leaders, youth, and families with biblical servant leadership principles, practical leadership skills, entrepreneurship, and economic opportunities that foster sustainable community transformation.
vmv_values_intro: These are the commitments we are willing to be measured against — in the training room, in the office, and at home.
vmv_value_christ_body: We practice and promote ethical leadership that answers to Christ first.
vmv_value_servant_body: We serve to meet practical and spiritual needs, in that order and both at once.
vmv_value_integrity_body: We are a transparent and trustworthy ministry that reflects Jesus.
vmv_value_steward_body: We honor the resources and the people God has entrusted to us.
vmv_value_excellence_body: We serve with excellence, knowing we represent God in our work, words, and actions.
vmv_value_transform_body: We work for changed leadership in workplaces, in young people, and in marriages.
